items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: You told me before that he was your first trumpet player.

ctx.x: He liked number two. Number two. Keep enjoying that.
Mr. Bray, what kind of a style is Sugar John? You told me before that he was your first trumpet player. Nice trumpet player. What kind of a style did he play? I don't know. I couldn't tell you.
But he's a smooth trumpet player. He's a pretty honest style of bunk. Bunkway on smooth. On the order of bunk too. Yeah, smooth, smooth trumpet player. Good morning.
